content.value: A 100 mm diameter tube well produces 70 l/s with a drawdown of 4 m and the (12) circle of influence of 100 m in diameter. The static depth of water in the well is 42 m. Calculate the coefficient of permeability of the aquifer in which the tube well is sunk.
